import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
# State rows are rows 8 to 58 (Excel rows 9 to 59)
data = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
# Total motor-fuel consumption across all categories is column R (index 17)
data[17] = pd.to_numeric(data[17])
top3 = data.sort_values(by=17, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].astype(str).str.replace(r'\s*\(\d+\)', '', regex=True).str.strip().tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
data = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
# Highway use combined gasoline and gasohol total is column F (index 5)
ny_val = pd.to_numeric(data[data[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'New York'].iloc[0, 5])
fl_val = pd.to_numeric(data[data[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida'].iloc[0, 5])
result = 'Florida' if fl_val > ny_val else 'New York'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
data = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
# Percent change from prior year in total highway use is column O (index 14)
growth = pd.to_numeric(data[14], errors='coerce')
result = int((growth > 0).sum())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
data = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
# Losses allowed for evaporation/handling is column K (index 10)
losses = pd.to_numeric(data[10], errors='coerce')
# Total nonhighway use of gasoline and gasohol is column I (index 8)
nonhighway = pd.to_numeric(data[8], errors='coerce')
result = int(nonhighway[losses < 0].sum())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_motor_fuel_use_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MF-21', header=None)
data = df.iloc[8:59].copy()
# Column R (index 17) is SUMMARY OF TOTAL USE - TOTAL
tx_total = pd.to_numeric(data[data[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Texas'].iloc[0, 17])
ca_total = pd.to_numeric(data[data[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'].iloc[0, 17])
result = 'yes' if tx_total > ca_total else 'no'
